evidence.observation: Sensor not installed; atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified during growth
Tube pressure rising monotonically during growth: 2.90 -> 3.18 Torr while Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm
Temperature holds 750 °C with heater power ~45%, control appears normal
